en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of an interior, specifically an old hall with vaulted stone ceilings and gothic arches. Visible are ornate wooden chairs, a round table with an open book, mounted antlers, a suit of armor, and a staircase. The setting has a historical medieval atmosphere and the image caption at the bottom reads 'Burg Kreuzenstein. Rittersaal'.
